name: Boku no Shuukatsu Nikki
source:
Main character begins job hunting. He spends time with his friend who got a job recently and with helpful and attentive human resource manager. Employment is a war, but love starts to bloom at unexpected places sometimes. Will protagonist find a job?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公开始求职。他与最近找到工作的朋友，以及亲切体贴的人事经理共度时光。就业是一场战争，但爱情有时会在意想不到的地方萌芽。主人公能找到工作吗？

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]]
